marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 15 knots increasing to northwest 20 this evening
then diminishing to light late overnight. Wind increasing to southeast 15 Friday
morning and to southeast 25 near noon Friday. Scattered flurries ending Friday morning. Visibility as low
as 1 mile in flurries. Low tonight minus 1. High Friday plus 4. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 to 2 metres subsiding to 1 or less late
overnight then building to 1 to 2 Friday afternoon.<br/>
